$description: Southville Running Club brand tokens. A MIRROR of styles/tokens.css, which is canonical and is what ships; tests/brand.test.ts fails if the two disagree. Adopted from bindalshah/src-race-timing's own design-tokens.json (docs/foundations/race-timing-brand-guidelines.md) on 16 August 2026, superseding the 'not compared' note in docs/foundations/brand.md. This file exists so the palette can be diffed against that repository's and imported into Figma (Tokens Studio) without anybody retyping a hex code.

green.$description: color.primary from the race-timing app's guidelines, adopted 16 August 2026. Surfaces and the logo only: 2.19:1 on white, below even the 3:1 floor for large text and non-text UI, let alone the 4.5:1 body-text floor. Charcoal ink on it is 6.26:1. WCAG sets no contrast floor for a logotype.

greenText.$description: The brand green at a lightness that can be read. Hue and saturation held. 7.04:1 on white.

greenTextDark.$description: The same, for the dark scheme. 7.00:1 on the dark page. The guideline defines no dark palette; this is derived, not specified.

slate.$description: color.slate. Already adopted from the timing app's tokens before this change, so unchanged: 7.53:1 on white.

slateDark.$description: Muted text on the dark page, 7.72:1. The guideline gives no dark-mode slate; unchanged from this repository's existing value.

error.$description: Derived from color.danger (#E53935): raw value is 4.15:1 on white, AA-large-only. Hue and saturation held, lightness moved to 7.04:1 for AAA body text.

danger.$description: color.danger, undiluted. Non-text and large-scale use only — icons, borders, DNF fills — never body text; see error above.

warning.$description: color.warning. 1.80:1 on white — decorative and large-scale only. Ink on it is 7.64:1.

paperDark.$description: Page background, dark scheme. The guideline defines no dark palette; unchanged from this repository's existing value.

band.$description: The site banner band. A pale tint of the new brand hue (147°), re-derived from the old tint's hue (129°). Ink on it is 12.78:1; the green-text link is 6.45:1.

bandDark.$description: The site banner band, dark scheme.

font.$description: The guideline's preferred faces (Halyard Display, Inter Display, IBM Plex Mono) are not vendored and Halyard is not licensed for this domain; see docs/foundations/brand.md. Inter and JetBrains Mono are vendored at apps/main/public/fonts and are the guideline's own fallback once Halyard is set aside.

display.value: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

body.value: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

radius.$description: Unchanged: the same values bindalshah/src-race-timing carries as radius.button and radius.card, and the same ones nn-theme.css independently landed on as --nn-r-btn and --nn-r-card.

targetTextRatio.$description: This repository targets AAA for text rather than the AA floor the guideline itself sets. Every derived colour above was found by holding hue and saturation and moving lightness until it cleared 7:1 on the surface it is used on.

logo.$description: The wordmark is packages/shared/src/brand.ts (geometry) and apps/main/public/logo.svg (the standalone asset). It has no colour of its own — it is filled with currentColor and takes the colour of whatever renders it. Unaffected by this change.
